report_markdown:
**Competitor content: Company blogs and YouTube on AP automation** 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-16
Billcraft's invoice-fraud demonstration reached 21,300 views as of 2026-11-16—5.26× its six-video comparison median of 4,050.

**Payflow**: 3 pieces. E-invoicing, AP automation research and an AI-matching webinar announcement.
- [How e-invoicing v2 changes your AP stack](https://payflow.example/blog/einvoicing-v2-ap-stack) (article, Nov 12).
- [State of AP 2026: 300 finance leaders on automation](https://payflow.example/blog/state-of-ap-2026) (report, Nov 10). Public listing only; the report download requires a work email.
- [Webinar: Closing faster with AI matching (Nov 20)](https://payflow.example/events/closing-faster-ai-matching) (webinar, Nov 13), co-hosted with Northbank Business Banking. Nov 13 is the listing date; the event is Nov 20.
Source: [supplied Payflow archive](https://payflow.example/blog), read 2026-11-16. No engagement metrics were visible.

**Billcraft**: 1 piece. Invoice-fraud detection demonstrated on video.
- [We tried to fake a vendor invoice (and our AP tool caught it)](https://youtube.example/watch?v=bc111) (video, Nov 11), 21,300 views as of 2026-11-16.
Outperformer: this video earned 5.26× the 4,050-view median of the six other videos shown. Their counts were 4,100, 3,800, 5,200, 3,900, 4,600 and 4,000, all read 2026-11-16. The median is the average of 4,000 and 4,100. This is a snapshot comparison, not age-normalized performance.
Source: [supplied Billcraft videos archive](https://youtube.example/@billcraft/videos).

**Gaps**
- **1099-NEC vendor-flagging setup:** A Nov 12 r/Accounting thread asks for configuration help, with 520 points and 180 comments as of 2026-11-16; its top comment requests practical vendor-flagging steps ([source](https://reddit.example/r/Accounting/comments/9k3p2/)). No listed rival's in-window title addresses this request. For Ledgerly blog, read by controllers at mid-size US companies: publish a setup checklist with field mappings, exception tests and year-end checks. Verify the applicable legal threshold first; the thread's premise was not independently checked.

_No prior reported pieces were supplied, so no repeats were dropped. Coverage uses the supplied archive snapshots; the gated report body was not reviewed, so its detailed coverage remains unknown._
